findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scrape_url · Private data: lending_grade, lookup_wallet, resolve_name, caller_id · Public sink: resolve_name, caller_id · Destructive: search_web, scrape_url, lookup_wallet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scrape_url · Private data: lending_grade, lookup_wallet, resolve_name, caller_id · Public sink: resolve_name, caller_id · Destructive: search_web, scrape_url, lookup_wallet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_wallet" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
